{{Top|leg}}
The '''R-PB6 repair system''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] repair system produced by [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The system launched short-range [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] capable of repairing the hulls of nearby starships.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' {{1st}}
